We need to model the described process as one BPMN process with one pool (organisation) and lanes for each actor (person, role, department, system). Actors: customer, system, warehouse team, logistics provider. Customer places order (activity) - could be considered external participant? Probably part of same pool? The description says process begins when a customer places an order through an online platform or over the phone. That's an external trigger from customer, but can be modeled as a start event perhaps with a message? Use lane "Customer". System automatically generates order confirmation - lane "System". Warehouse team picks and packs items and generates shipping label – lane "Warehouse". Hand over to logistics provider – lane "Logistics Provider". Tracking info sent to customer – lane "System" maybe or "Logistics"? Could be system again. Shipment monitored until reaches address – maybe system monitoring? Could be a task "Monitor shipment" in system lane. After successful delivery, end; but feedback or returns may trigger further actions – optional path after end? Could model an exclusive gateway after delivery: either end or go to "Handle feedback/return" – lane maybe "Customer Service". Since not defined, could add lane "Customer Service". However requirement: use one lane for each actor that performs activities. Feedback may trigger further actions – that is an activity not described, could be omitted? But we should represent that possibility: after delivery, an exclusive gateway with "Feedback/Return?" leading to a task "Handle feedback/return" (maybe in "Customer Service") and then end. Without feedback, end.

System automatically generates order confirmation and sends to customer – task "Generate order confirmation" (System). Could be followed by "Send order confirmation" but combine.

Warehouse picks and packs items and shipping label – could be combined into one task "Pick and pack items and generate shipping label". Lane Warehouse.

Hand over to logistics provider – task "Hand over to logistics provider" lane Logistics.

Tracking info sent to customer – task "Send tracking information" lane System (or Logistics). Choose System.

Monitor shipment – task "Monitor shipment" lane System.

Exclusive gateway after monitor: either "Successful delivery" leads to end, or "Feedback/Return" leads to task "Handle feedback or return" lane Customer Service then end.
